title: Different Ways to Print
code:
print ('Hello World!')
print ("Hello World!")
print ('''Hello World!''')
print ("""Hello World!""")

lines.explanation: One way to print a string is to enclose the string inside single quotation marks
Another way to print out a string is to enclose the string inside double quotation marks
One more way to printing out strings is to put it between Three-Single Quotes. This is used to print out large strings that typically exceeds more than one line
Strings can also be printed with Three-Double Quotes. Similar to the previous example, this is also used to print out large strings that typically exceeds more than one line
